# R reference fixtures

`survey_binary.csv` is a synthetic complex-survey fixture with two strata and
two PSUs per stratum. After R and the locked packages are installed,
`scripts/r/survey_reference.R` writes the canonical Taylor-linearized
proportion, SE, logit CI, DEFF, design degrees of freedom and Kish ESS.

Reference outputs are intentionally not fabricated while `Rscript` is absent.
They must be generated by the locked R environment and then compared with any
secondary Python implementation using the tolerances in `experiment.yaml`.
